groups.title: Canonical backlog classification and governance pack
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: The working tree now has a canonical grouped backlog view instead of relying only on the raw 2140-item matrix.
groups.still_missing: This grouped truth layer does not replace the raw matrix or the future checkpoint-bound evidence from the real owned training run.

groups.title: Source-of-truth map, document ownership, and closure constitution
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: Current authoritative docs, generated reports, and historical snapshots are separated.
groups.still_missing: Future release snapshots must continue to honor this authority order.

groups.title: Claim registry and final truth matrix
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: Closure-critical claims now map to evidence, mode, and missing proof instead of living only as prose.
groups.still_missing: Real-run claims remain pending until the real owned training run produces their artifacts.

groups.title: Code-truth gate, maturity labels, and four-column done rule
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: The repo now defines done-ness through code path, canonical command, verification, and artifact evidence, and it labels critical technical surfaces by maturity instead of flattening them into one production story.
groups.still_missing: Real optimized-production claims still require measured artifacts and backend-specific proof.

groups.title: Frozen, maintained, and living surface policy
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: Frozen governance surfaces are now separated from maintained verification surfaces and living implementation or product surfaces.
groups.still_missing: Lane-by-lane lifecycle assignment still needs to stay current as the repo evolves.

groups.title: Workspace hygiene manifest and quarantine-first cleanup policy
groups.what_is_done: Workspace hygiene now emits written keep/quarantine/ignore decisions before any destructive action.
groups.still_missing: Any actual quarantine apply step still requires reviewed operator intent.

groups.title: Canonical closure commands and current entrypoint mapping
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: The repo now has a canonical zero-touch main-run launcher plus the existing verification and release ladders.
groups.still_missing: Real-run evidence remains separate from the command ladder and will appear only after the actual owned training run.

groups.title: Exact train-readiness contract and blocker reason codes
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: The repo emits a deterministic TRAIN_ALLOWED or NOT_ALLOWED decision with exact reason codes.
groups.still_missing: Repo-side readiness is green via remote_bootstrap. Remaining non-winning exact blockers: offline_clean:PRECOMPUTED_LOGITS_MISSING_AND_PHASE0_NOT_ACTIONABLE, online_teacher:MISSING_HF_TOKEN.

groups.title: Data pipeline contract, provenance, and tokenizer or teacher policy hardening
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: The stage1..stage5 JSONL files exist, the offline tokenizer cache is accepted, and the offline-clean data path is green.
groups.still_missing: Claim-grade corpus lineage, large-scale provenance, and the real owned training-run consumption journal remain post-run evidence.

groups.title: Freeze manifests and canonical handoff surfaces
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: Freeze and handoff surfaces exist and refresh with the closure flow.
groups.still_missing: They still need the real trained outputs to become final release evidence.

groups.title: Zero-touch train-end orchestration and post-train autorun
groups.timing_bucket: required before a real main run
groups.what_is_done: A real zero-touch train-end launcher, run-lock contract, mode flags, and post-train state machine now exist in the working tree.
groups.still_missing: The remaining missing items are the external real-run outputs, not the orchestration layer itself.

groups.title: Trained outputs, benchmark evidence, demos, and final release artifacts
groups.what_is_done: The repo now names these artifacts explicitly as post-run evidence rather than pretending they already exist.
groups.still_missing: A real owned training run, trained final weights, best and latest checkpoints, benchmark summaries, demo bundle, and checkpoint-bound evidence pack are still missing.

groups.title: XLA or TPU, cloud expansion, and long-horizon scale-up work
groups.what_is_done: The raw backlog already distinguishes deferred scale-up work from the closure-critical path.
groups.still_missing: Actual implementation and proof remain future work.

groups.title: Company, legal, GTM, investor, and operational mega-band
groups.what_is_done: This band is now explicitly called out instead of being silently mixed into technical closure truth.
groups.still_missing: Customer, legal, procurement, pricing, SLA, GTM, and company-governance execution packages remain open.
